title: 66--R10 SEMD: Handheld X-ray Fluorescence Analyzers (XRFs)
agency_path: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY.ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY.REGION 7 CONTRACTING OFFICE
detail_text: This is a Request for Information (RFI) and is for market research purposes. Please do not submit quotes. This is to seek interest about the requirement. The purpose of this purchase order is to purchase (2) Handheld X-ray Fluorescence Analyzers (XRFs); (1) XRF Pole; and (2) XRF Bi-pods or equal. See Line Items and the attached Specifications for more information.
